text: dsh-local-ai 是把本地模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，可将 Ollama 注册为模型提供方，并为 LM Studio、vLLM、llama.cpp 等 OpenAI 兼容服务注册独立提供方。它按任务类型、关键词或始终匹配规则路由请求，支持本地模型映射、发现、查看、拉取、移除和健康检查，并提供 /ollama 状态命令。本地路由在开始输出前失败时可回退云端；适合希望在 DSH 中使用本地推理或管理 Ollama 模型的用户。需配置可用的本地模型服务。

dsh-local-ai connects Ollama and compatible local servers to DeepSeek Harness. It registers model providers, routes requests by task or keyword, and can fall back to cloud on early failure. Tools manage models; health checks and /ollama show status. Configure a reachable local model service.

有没有办法按提示里的关键词自动选用本地模型？

Can DSH use my local LM Studio or vLLM server as a model provider?
I need local model routing based on a task purpose or matching keywords.
dsh-local-ai 的「本地模型路由」按 purpose、关键词或 always 规则选择目标模型和提供方；配置在 route 列表中，匹配后提交到本地模型。
dsh-local-ai 的「Ollama 模型管理」提供 ollama_list、ollama_show、ollama_pull 和 ollama_remove 工具，用于列出、查看、拉取和删除本地模型。
dsh-local-ai 的「兼容后端」可将配置的 LM Studio、vLLM 或 llama.cpp 服务注册为 openai:<name> 提供方，并通过 OpenAI 聊天补全接口生成响应。
dsh-local-ai 的「健康与状态」通过 ollama_health 工具或 /ollama 命令分别报告 API 响应和进程探测结果，并显示模型清单和建议。
dsh-local-ai 的「请求回退」在路由到本地提供方后、尚未产生内容时遇到失败，会继续调用原请求的 next() 路径。
dsh-local-ai 默认 route 规则为空，因此不会自动改道；只有添加匹配规则或明确选择本地提供方，请求才会发往本地模型。
dsh-local-ai 会把模型请求发送到配置的 Ollama 或兼容后端；健康检查还会使用 ollama CLI 探测进程。

dsh-local-ai README · 核心能力：- **发现与管理** —— `ollama_list`（已安装模型、运行中模型、磁盘占用）、`ollama_show`（参数尺寸、量化、上下文长度）、`ollama_pull`、`ollama_remove`。
- **健康检查** —— 进程存活（经 `ollama` CLI）与 API 响应（经 `/api/version`），作为两个独立信号报告。
- **官方适配器** —— 通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter`（`LlmAdapter`）注册 `ollama` provider 路由，支持配置模型映射与 temperature / max-tokens / stop 参数翻译。
- **OpenAI 兼容后端** —— LM Studio、vLLM、llama.cpp `--server` 各自经同一个 `LlmAdapter` seam 注册为 `openai:<name>` provider，复用一份 OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` 适配器（纯文本路由）。
- **本地路由** —— `model_route` 规则按任务类型（`purpose`）、不区分大小写的关键词或 `always` 分流，本地路由在产出内容前失败时自动回退云端。
- **`/ollama` 命令** —— 一键状态总览：模型、磁盘占用、健康与建议。
- **零依赖、HTTP 优先** —— 一切走 Ollama 的 HTTP API（CLI 仅用于进程探测）；不捆绑模型文件。

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：<details>
<summary>Ollama 挂了或端点不通，会把对话搞崩吗？</summary>

不会。路由监听器在本地路由产出首个 token 前失败时回退云端（`next()`），所以一个宕掉的 Ollama 不会卡死对话；`/ollama` 总览是 best-effort，服务器宕机也不会抛错。**唯一例外**：带 `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED` 的失败会被重新抛出，不回退云端（见「安全边界」）；首个 token 之后才失败则原样透传，无法回退。

</details>

<details>
<summary>请求发到哪里？插件会存我的数据吗？</summary>

只向你在 `baseURL` / `backends[].baseURL` 配置的端点发起 `network:outbound` 请求。插件不读文件系统、不建存储、不存凭据；展示给模型或用户的模型列表、健康事实与错误消息都会先脱敏——去掉端点 userinfo 与密钥查询参数、剥离控制字符、限制长度。工具与命令结果由 harness 自身的 tool/command seam 记录。

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：</details>

<details>
<summary>默认会不会把请求偷偷改走本地？</summary>

不会。`route` 列表默认为空；只有显式规则命中，或你显式选择 `ollama` / `openai:<name>` provider 时，请求才会到达本地模型。

</details>

<details>
<summary>会和 dsh-routing-suite 这类插件抢 `llm/stream` 吗？</summary>

不会。`llm/stream` 是 Cordis 广播事件：每个监听器都会运行，任何一个都无法饿死其他监听器；本插件的监听器总是经 `next()` 委托，只有本地路由实际服务时才短路。它不提供任何服务键、不注册 `webServer` 前缀、不改写全局对象。逐条论证见「与其他 DSH 插件的互操作性」。

</details>

<details>
<summary>能跑视觉模型吗？</summary>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：能，但取决于模型自报能力：`/api/show` capabilities 含 `vision` 的模型会声明 `inputModalities: ["text","image"]` 并在用户消息上携带 base64 图片载荷（可用 `vision: false` 退出）；纯文本模型仍拒绝图片内容（`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`）。

</details>

dsh-local-ai README · 安全边界：- **默认不重路由** —— `route` 列表默认为空；请求只有通过显式规则或显式选择 `ollama` provider 才会到达本地模型。
- **展示前脱敏** —— 端点地址与本地路径在进入工具输出、`/ollama` 命令或错误消息前都会被脱敏。
- **零捆绑模型** —— 下载与存储是 Ollama 自己的事；包内不含任何模型。
- **失败响亮、失败可控** —— 非法配置导致挂载失败；本地路由在产出内容前失败会回退云端（`next()`），因此 Ollama 宕机不会卡死对话。**唯一例外**：带 `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED` 的失败会被重新抛出而不回退云端——该码是官方图像卸载回路在要求这条本地路由卸下保留图片，回退会跳过回路并把本应只在本地的请求静默发往远端提供方。
- **模型可见 ⟺ 已记录** —— 路由只改变由哪个提供方服务请求（assistant 消息会以 `ollama` 来源记录）；不凭空新增模型可见输入。

dsh-local-ai README · 权限与数据：- **权限**：对您配置的 Ollama 端点使用 `network:outbound`；无原生代码、无文件系统访问、无存储。
- **数据**：展示给模型或用户的每个模型列表/详情、健康事实与错误消息在展示前都经过脱敏（去除端点 userinfo 与密钥查询参数、剥离控制字符、限制长度）。工具与命令结果由 harness 自身的 tool/command 机制记录。
- **凭据**：插件不存储也不读取任何凭据。它只向您配置的端点发起 HTTP 请求，外加本地 `ollama list` 进程探测。

dsh-local-ai README · 已知限制：- **npm 0.2.0-rc.2** —— 针对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2` 开发与测试；更新版本的 harness 基线预期可用，但由每月 compat workflow 验证。
- **模型声明 vision 时启用视觉** —— `/api/show` capabilities 含 `vision` 的模型声明 `inputModalities: ["text","image"]`，并在用户消息上携带 base64 图片载荷（可用 `vision: false` 退出）；纯文本模型仍拒绝图片内容（`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`）。
- **中途失败不回退** —— 本地路由一旦开始产出内容，之后的失败会透传（无法撤回）；只有首个 token 前的失败才回退云端。

dsh-local-ai README · 与其他 DSH 插件的互操作性：已对照 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**（本 README 面向的运行时）与 2026-10-05 实测的高星插件集验证。

本插件**不干扰**其他插件，包括广泛安装的高星插件：

- **无工具名冲突。** 所有工具都带命名空间，不占用任何已被内置工具或其他插件持有的裸名。
- **无服务键冲突。** 不提供任何服务键，因此不存在服务键冲突。
- **无 slot 冲突。** 不注册客户端 slot key，因此不参与 `shadows-shipped-ui` 座位争抢。
- **无 HTTP 路由冲突。** 不注册任何 `webServer` 前缀。
- **无 patch 层冲突。** 组合包 patch 只 `insert` 自己那一行，从不覆写内置行的 `config`。
- **无全局改写。** 不改原型、不改写 `process.env`、不替换全局 fetch dispatcher。

dsh-local-ai README · 与其他 DSH 插件的互操作性：**共享事件监听器在构造上就不互相干扰。** 它用 `ctx.on()` 监听顺序敏感事件 `llm/stream` —— Cordis 的**广播**语义：每个监听器都会运行，任何一个都无法饿死其他监听器。**此处每个监听器都通过 `next()` 委托**，因此链条绝不会被短路；改写作用在 `next()` 产出的值上，而不是用它顶替返回：

- `llm/stream` — also used by `dsh-routing-suite` (7000★).

静态证据：`dsh-plugin-doctor` 的 K10–K13 在本仓全部为 `pass`。

dsh-local-ai README · dsh-local-ai：**Hook Ollama into DeepSeek Harness so local models become a routable first-class provider — requests go local by rule and fall back to the cloud when they fail.**

A headless, pure-host plugin: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route by task type or keyword, and get a one-shot status overview from `/ollama` — all in one bundle.

dsh-local-ai README · What it is：`dsh-local-ai` makes Ollama a first-class local provider inside DeepSeek Harness: it registers the `ollama` provider route, routes requests to local models by task type or keyword, and falls back to the cloud automatically when a local route fails before producing content. Five tools cover model discovery, pulling, removal, inspection, and health; `/ollama` gives a one-screen status overview. Everything talks to Ollama's HTTP API (the CLI is used only for the process probe); no model files are bundled and no new model-visible input is invented.

dsh-local-ai README · Core capabilities：- **Discovery & management** — `ollama_list` (installed models, running models, disk usage), `ollama_show` (parameter size, quantization, context length), `ollama_pull`, and `ollama_remove`.
- **Health check** — process liveness (via the `ollama` CLI) and API responsiveness (via `/api/version`), reported as two independent signals.
- **Official adapter** — the `ollama` provider route is registered through `ctx.llm.registerAdapter` (`LlmAdapter`), with configurable model mapping and temperature / max-tokens / stop translation.
- **OpenAI-compatible backends** — LM Studio, vLLM, and llama.cpp `--server` each register as their own `openai:<name>` provider through the same `LlmAdapter` seam, reusing one OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` adapter (text-only route).
- **Local routing** — `model_route` rules route requests to a local model by task type (`purpose`), case-insensitive keyword, or `always`, with automatic fallback to the cloud when the local route fails before producing content.
- **`/ollama` command** — a one-shot status overview: models, disk usage, health, and suggestions.
- **Zero dependencies, HTTP first** — everything talks to Ollama's

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：<details>
<summary>Will a down Ollama or an unreachable endpoint brick the conversation?</summary>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：No. The routing listener falls back to the cloud (`next()`) when a local route fails before producing its first token, so a dead Ollama never blocks a conversation; the `/ollama` overview is best-effort and never throws on a down server. **One carve-out**: a failure carrying `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED` is rethrown instead of retried on the cloud (see "Security boundaries"); a failure after the first token is forwarded verbatim and cannot be retracted.

</details>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：<details>
<summary>Where do requests go? Does the plugin store my data?</summary>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：It only makes `network:outbound` requests to the endpoints you configure in `baseURL` / `backends[].baseURL`. It performs no filesystem access, creates no storage, and stores no credentials. Every model list/detail, health fact, and error message shown to the model or the user is sanitized first — endpoint userinfo and secret query params are dropped, control characters stripped, and lengths bounded. Tool and command results are logged by the harness's own tool/command seams.

</details>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：<details>
<summary>Does it silently re-route my requests to a local model by default?</summary>

No. The `route` list is empty by default; a request reaches a local model only through an explicit matching rule or an explicit `ollama` / `openai:<name>` provider selection.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Does it fight plugins like dsh-routing-suite over `llm/stream`?</summary>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：No. `llm/stream` is a Cordis broadcast event: every listener runs and none can starve another; this plugin's listener always delegates through `next()` and short-circuits only when a local route is actually serving. It provides no service key, registers no `webServer` prefix, and mutates no globals. The point-by-point argument is in "Interoperability with other DSH plugins".

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can it run vision models?</summary>

dsh-local-ai README · FAQ：Yes, when the model reports the capability: a model whose `/api/show` capabilities include `vision` declares `inputModalities: ["text","image"]` and carries base64 image payloads on user messages (opt out with `vision: false`); text-only models still reject image content (`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`).

</details>

dsh-local-ai README · Security boundaries：- **No re-routing by default** — the `route` list is empty unless you opt in; a request reaches a local model only through an explicit rule or an explicit `ollama` provider selection.
- **Sanitize before display** — endpoint addresses and local paths are sanitized before they reach tool output, the `/ollama` command, or error messages.
- **Zero bundled models** — downloads and storage are Ollama's own responsibility; nothing is shipped in the package.
- **Failure loud, failure contained** — invalid config fails the mount; a local route that fails before producing content falls back to the cloud (`next()`), so a down Ollama never bricks a conversation. **One carve-out:** a failure carrying `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED` is rethrown instead of retried on the cloud — that code is the official offload circuit asking this same local route to drop retained images, and falling back would skip the circuit while silently sending a local-only request to a remote provider.
- **Model-visible ⟺ logged** — routing only changes which provider serves a request (the assistant message is logged with its `ollama` provenance); no new model-visible input is invented.

dsh-local-ai README · Permissions & data：- **Permissions**: `network:outbound` to the Ollama endpoint you configure; no native code, no filesystem access, no storage.
- **Data**: every model list/detail, health fact, and error message shown to the model or the user is sanitized (endpoint userinfo and secret query params dropped, control characters stripped, lengths bounded) before display. Tool and command results are logged by the harness's own tool/command seams.
- **Credentials**: the plugin stores and reads no credentials. It only issues HTTP requests to the endpoint you configure, plus the local `ollama list` process probe.

dsh-local-ai README · Known limitations：- **npm 0.2.0-rc.2** — developed and tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`; newer harness baselines are expected to work but are verified by the monthly compat workflow.
- **Vision when the model reports it** — models whose `/api/show` capabilities include `vision` declare `inputModalities: ["text","image"]` and carry base64 image payloads on user messages (opt out with `vision: false`); text-only models still reject image content (`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`).
- **Mid-stream fallback** — once a local route has started producing content, a later failure is forwarded (not retracted); only a failure before the first token falls back to the cloud.

dsh-local-ai README · Interoperability with other DSH plugins：Verified against **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (the runtime this README ships for) and the high-star plugin set surveyed on 2026-10-05.

This plugin **does not interfere** with other plugins, including the widely installed high-star ones:

dsh-local-ai README · Interoperability with other DSH plugins：- **No tool-name collision.** Every tool is namespaced; no bare name owned by a shipped tool or another plugin is registered.
- **No service-key collision.** It provides no service key at all, so it cannot collide on one.
- **No slot collision.** It registers no client slot key, so it cannot contend for a `shadows-shipped-ui` seat.
- **No HTTP route collision.** It registers no `webServer` prefix.
- **No patch-layer collision.** The bundle patch only `insert`s its own row; it never overrides a built-in row's `config`.
- **No global mutation.** It does not patch prototypes, rewrite `process.env`, or replace the global fetch dispatcher.

dsh-local-ai README · Interoperability with other DSH plugins：**Shared event listeners are non-interfering by construction.** It observes the ordering-sensitive event `llm/stream` with `ctx.on()` — Cordis's broadcast registration, where every listener runs and none can starve another. **Every listener here delegates through `next()`**, so the chain is never short-circuited, and a mutation is applied to the value `next()` produced rather than returned in its place:

- `llm/stream` — also used by `dsh-routing-suite` (7000★).
